title: Aao Chale Karbala
body:
hai hamari dars gaah karbala karbala
haq ka seedha rasta karbala karbala
chalo chalo hame tumhe pukarti hai karbala
<<DIVIDER>>
chalte raho saath liye saara zamana
aao chale karbobala ban ke safeerane aza
tum bhi chalo hum bhi chale
saath ho zehra ki dua
aao chale karbobala ban ke safeerane aza
<<DIVIDER>>
karbobala mein tumhe quran milega
fatema tuz zahra ka faizaan milega
tum ko har ek mulk ka insaan milega
parcham e abbas nigheban milega
chalte raho saath liye saara zamana
aao chale karbobala...
<<DIVIDER>>
aao chale parcham e abbas utha kar
shehr e najaf se chale karbobala mil kar
sheh ke azadaro ka ho saath samandar
pal mein badal jayega hum sab ka muqadar
chalte raho saath liye saara zamana
aao chale karbobala...
<<DIVIDER>>
dene chale pursa hussain ibne ali ka
nauha padhe chal ke alamdar e jari ka
momino matam kare humshakle nabi ka
qasim o baysheer ka pursa de sabhi ka
chalte raho saath liye saara zamana
aao chale karbobala...
<<DIVIDER>>
shukr e khuda maula ke zawaar bane hum
aal e mohamed ke tarafdaar bane hum
hyder e karaar ke hub daar bane hum
zehra ke bachon ke azadaar bane hum
chalte raho saath liye saara zamana
aao chale karbobala...
<<DIVIDER>>
maango dua unki bhi poori ho duayein
dete hai maula ko jo ro ro ke sadayein
maula mere jald unhe dar pe bulayein
karte huwe matam e shabbir wo aayein
chalte raho saath liye saara zamana
aao chale karbobala...
author: N. Sarwar, J. Jaffri & A. Shanawar
